name: Military Training
description: Drills and discipline forge raw recruits into soldiers. Unlocks heavier infantry, archers, guardians, and the barracks to train them.

name: Siege Engineering
description: Walls that cannot be breached by sword must be broken by stone. Unlocks the catapult, the great equalizer against fortifications.

name: Arcane Studies
description: The first steps into forbidden knowledge. Scholars learn to bend the elements to their will, unlocking the mage as a weapon of war.

name: Elemental Mastery
description: When the elements answer to your hand, no armor provides shelter. Mages gain power and a sharper edge to their spells.

name: Cavalry
description: The art of mounted warfare. Unlocks the Knight — a devastating charge unit that deals bonus damage after moving.
